title: electrive: Stellantis enables Supercharger use with NACS adapter
notes: Stellantis BEVs in North America can use Tesla Superchargers with the Free2move Charge NACS-CCS1 adapter: Charger Daytona 2024-2026, Wagoneer S 2024-2025, Recon 2026, Fiat 500e 2024-2026. The 2027 Charger Daytona is the first Stellantis model with a standard NACS port. Canada is implied (North America) but not listed separately.
